title: Space class collapses when the bound vanishes
statement: Let $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and suppose $s(n)=0$ for at least one natural number $n$. Then the class of languages decidable in space $s$ up to a constant factor equals the class decidable in space identically zero.
